title: Notes

rules.spreadRule: Skip a book when YES ask minus YES bid is 40 or more.
rules.gapYes: Fair minus YES ask. Needs fair at 56% or more.
rules.gapNo: YES bid minus fair. NO ask = 100 minus YES bid. Needs fair at 45% or less.
rules.labels: Likely YES 78%+, Lean YES 56%+, Toss-up 46–55%, Lean NO 22–45%, Likely NO under 22%.
rules.yellow: Yellow strike text means the word is not part of the standard every-rally template.

edit: Change fairYes (a YES percent) and context on a strike. The site recomputes the call, the gap, and best spots from fairYes plus data/prices.json.
